rows.english: Please wait for the current operation.
rows.backtranslation: Wait until this task ends.

independent_semantic_review.linguistic_reason: CHIYA sense2 (PDF110/printed95) directly attests ximochiya as the singular wait instruction. AZTAH sense2 (PDF54/printed39) defines the end boundary of ongoing work and uses a present-form event after aztah. TLAMI1 sense2 (PDF517/printed502) is intransitive ending of a task. NI3 (PDF354/printed339) and TEQUITL (PDF461/printed446) support this task. The composed clause therefore means wait until this task ends. Work/task is extended to the app operation; no tense or causative completion form has been invented.
independent_semantic_review.caller_reason: The four references cover startup170, regular/panel button guards549/555, and non-autosave legacy-credit attachment1444. Busy is not confined to saving. beginIo1420 and endIo1421 count work in flight, and the startup screen has its own busy state. The phrasing remains generic about the cause and tells the user to wait; it does not promise success, saving, a short duration, or automatic retry.
retained_limits: The courteous English please is conveyed as a neutral instruction, not an independently attested politeness word.
This task refers to the current blocking work; it does not guarantee that one completion alone clears every concurrent busy cause.

rows.caller_scope: Four direct references: startup loading at ClassicPaintActivity170; regular and panel button busy guards549/555; non-autosave legacy-credit attachment busy guard1444.
